expectations.query: SELECT abs((SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.learning_outcomes) - (SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.gold.learning_outcomes_metrics))

SELECT count(*) FROM ((SELECT ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.silver.learning_outcomes EXCEPT SELECT ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.gold.learning_outcomes_metrics) UNION ALL (SELECT ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.gold.learning_outcomes_metrics EXCEPT SELECT ma_chuong_trinh, nam_hoc, hoc_ky FROM lakehouse.silver.learning_outcomes))

SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.learning_outcomes s FULL OUTER JOIN lakehouse.gold.learning_outcomes_metrics g ON s.ma_chuong_trinh = g.ma_chuong_trinh AND s.nam_hoc = g.nam_hoc AND s.hoc_ky = g.hoc_ky WHERE s.ma_chuong_trinh IS NULL OR g.ma_chuong_trinh IS NULL OR s.ma_ban_ghi <> g.source_record_id OR s._record_checksum <> g.source_record_checksum
